description: Said Thursday was three days old, and reported the loaf a full thumb short.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Called it a bad example, priced the loaf and the board, and named the sixpence for the morning.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Lay at the corner of the table while the book was open, and stayed when it shut.
name: Gib

description: Said a bad tooth takes rent of the head, and named Monday's shuttle.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Sat three pews ahead, turned away, and did not speak.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Preached, and turned the sand-glass twice.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Read the line, wrote nothing, and shut the book.
name: William Shakespeare
